lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Files_Confidential\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

lines: vendor/ ships 1 package that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 28 to 32. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.

psalm/phar, friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

lines: 2 uses in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 28 to 32. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.

The app reads and writes its app config in 2 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
